notes: Abell 426 (Brunzendorf+1999); ~500 members. Most X-ray luminous cluster in sky outside Coma. NGC1275 (Perseus A): Seyfert BCG driving AGN sound waves in ICM (Fabian+2011). NGC1265: head-tail radio galaxy — strong ram-pressure indicator. Cooling flow: dense E-dominated core; strong S0 outer zone (stripped infallers).
